company.description:
Finic is an e-commerce art company that manufactures and sells customized wall art in the form of canvas prints. Customers can upload photos, select detailed settings, and get the canvas prints shipped.

Finic was founded by in 2014 Vitaliy Rizhkov and is based in Portland, Oregon, United States.
